source.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּֽי־הֵחֵ֣ל הָֽאָדָ֔ם לָרֹ֖ב עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וּבָנ֖וֹת יֻלְּד֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was when began humankind to multiply on [the] face of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

en.L: And it happened, when {{gender:humankind|man}} began to multiply on the face of the ground and daughters were born to them,
en.B: When {{gender:people|men}} began to increase in number on the earth and daughters were born to them,
en.R: There came a time when there were many more people on the earth, and many daughters were born to them.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando {{gender:la humanidad|el hombre}} comenzó a multiplicarse sobre la superficie del suelo y les nacieron hijas,
es.B: Cuando {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} comenzaron a multiplicarse sobre la tierra y les nacieron hijas,
es.R: Llegó un tiempo en que había mucha más gente en la tierra, y les nacieron muchas hijas.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand {{gender:l’humanité|l’homme}} commença à se multiplier sur la face du sol et que des filles leur naquirent,
fr.B: Lorsque {{gender:les humains|les hommes}} commencèrent à se multiplier sur la terre et que des filles leur naquirent,
fr.R: Un jour, il y a eu beaucoup plus de gens sur la terre, et il leur est né beaucoup de filles.

sw.L: Ikawa, wanadamu walipoanza kuongezeka juu ya uso wa ardhi, na binti wakazaliwa kwao,
sw.B: Wanadamu walipoanza kuongezeka duniani, na binti wakazaliwa kwao,
sw.R: Wakati ulifika ambapo watu waliongezeka sana duniani, na binti wengi wakazaliwa kwao.

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi loài người bắt đầu gia tăng trên mặt đất và họ sinh được những con gái,
vi.B: Khi loài người bắt đầu gia tăng đông đúc trên mặt đất và sinh ra những con gái,
vi.R: Đến một thời kia, loài người trên mặt đất trở nên rất đông, và họ sinh ra nhiều con gái.

ko.L: 그리고 사람이 땅의 표면 위에서 많아지기 시작하고 그들에게 딸들이 태어났을 때에,
ko.B: 사람들이 땅 위에서 그 수가 늘어나기 시작하고 그들에게 딸들이 태어났을 때에,
ko.R: 세월이 흘러 땅 위에 사람들이 아주 많아졌다. 그리고 그들에게 많은 딸이 태어났다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, quando {{gender:a humanidade|o homem}} começou a se multiplicar sobre a face do solo e lhes nasceram filhas,
pt.B: Quando {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} começaram a se multiplicar na terra e lhes nasceram filhas,
pt.R: Chegou um tempo em que havia muito mais gente na terra, e essas pessoas tiveram muitas filhas.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሰው በመሬት ፊት ላይ መብዛት በጀመረ ጊዜ፣ ሴቶች ልጆችም በተወለዱላቸው ጊዜ፣
am.B: ሰዎች በምድር ላይ መብዛት በጀመሩና ሴቶች ልጆች በተወለዱላቸው ጊዜ፣
am.R: በምድር ላይ ሰዎች እጅግ የበዙበት ጊዜ መጣ፤ ብዙ ሴቶች ልጆችም ተወለዱላቸው።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब मनुष्य भूमि के मुख पर बढ़ने लगे, और उनके यहाँ बेटियाँ उत्पन्न हुईं,
hi.B: जब पृथ्वी पर मनुष्यों की संख्या बढ़ने लगी और उनके यहाँ बेटियाँ पैदा हुईं,
hi.R: एक समय ऐसा आया जब धरती पर लोग बहुत बढ़ गए, और उनके यहाँ बहुत सी बेटियाँ पैदा हुईं।

ru.L: И было, когда люди начали умножаться на лице земли и у них родились дочери,
ru.B: Когда люди стали умножаться на земле и у них рождались дочери,
ru.R: Пришло время, когда на земле стало намного больше людей, и у них родилось много дочерей.

uk.L: І сталося, коли люди почали множитися на поверхні землі й у них народилися дочки,
uk.B: Коли людей на землі стало більше і в них народилися дочки,
uk.R: Настав час, коли людей на землі стало дуже багато, і в них народилося багато дочок.

ja.L: そして、人が地の面に増え始め、彼らに娘たちが生まれたとき、
ja.B: 人が地上に増え始め、彼らに娘たちが生まれたとき、
ja.R: やがて、地上の人の数がとても多くなり、たくさんの娘たちが生まれるようになりました。

id.L: Dan terjadilah, ketika manusia mulai bertambah banyak di atas permukaan tanah dan anak-anak perempuan lahir bagi mereka,
id.B: Ketika manusia mulai bertambah banyak di bumi dan anak-anak perempuan lahir bagi mereka,
id.R: Lalu tiba waktunya manusia di bumi menjadi makin banyak, dan banyak anak perempuan lahir bagi mereka.

zh.L: 那时，人开始在地面上增多，又有女儿为他们出生，
zh.B: 人开始在地上增多，又有女儿为他们出生的时候，
zh.R: 后来，地上的人越来越多，他们也生了许多女儿。

tl.L: At nangyari, nang magsimulang dumami ang tao sa ibabaw ng lupa at may mga anak na babaing ipinanganak sa kanila,
tl.B: Nang magsimulang dumami ang mga tao sa lupa at may mga anak na babaing isinilang sa kanila,
tl.R: Dumating ang panahon na lubhang dumami ang mga tao sa lupa, at maraming anak na babae ang isinilang sa kanila.

decisions.choice: humankind: people in general
decisions.reason: The word is the one for humankind in 1:26 and 5:1-2, here people in general as they spread over the earth, fulfilling the command of 1:28.

decisions.choice: humankind (L), people (B); with the traditional setting, man or men
decisions.reason: As in 1:26, the word means human beings of both sexes, so the default is inclusive.

decisions.choice: passé simple (L, B); passé composé (R)
decisions.reason: French narrative tense by level, as the French style guide sets it: the passé simple of written narrative at Literal and Balanced ("commença", "naquirent"), the passé composé of spoken French at Readable ("il y a eu", "est né"). God's speeches keep the tenses of speech at every level.

decisions.choice: "ሰው", "ሰዎች" for humankind through 6:1-7, with no gender spans
decisions.reason: As in 1:26, the Amharic "ሰው" and "ሰዎች" already mean human beings, men and women, so the English choice between "humankind" and "man" (and between "they" and "he" in verse 3) has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic in this passage: pronouns and verbs for God are written once
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the reader's setting for capitalised pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic (see 1:1).

decisions.choice: "मनुष्य", no gender span
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: Hindi "मनुष्य" already means human beings of either sex, so the choice the English setting offers ("humankind" or "man") does not arise, and the Hindi has no span. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "люди", "человек", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Hebrew means people in general (m1). Russian "люди" and "человек" already include men and women, so where the English has "humankind" or "people" with the traditional "man" or "men", Russian needs no setting, in this chapter and the next.

decisions.choice: "люди", "дочки людей" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as the English
decisions.reason: Ukrainian "люди" and "людина" already mean people of both sexes (as in 1:26 and 5:1), so the English "humankind" or "man" choice does not arise; the same holds through 6:7.

decisions.choice: "人" (and "人の娘たち" in verses 2 and 4) with no gender span
decisions.reason: The word means people in general (m1); Japanese 人 already says that, so the English gender setting has nothing to switch, as in 1:26.

decisions.choice: "Dan terjadilah" (L)
decisions.reason: The narrative formula "and it came to pass" as the style guide sets it (section 12a): Literal "dan terjadilah", Balanced and Readable a time clause. As at 1:26, "manusia" carries no gender span.

decisions.choice: "人" with no gender span, through the chapter
decisions.reason: The English spans "humankind" (traditional "man"); Chinese "人" already means people in general (meaning decision m1) and needs no span. "And it came to pass" is "那时" at Literal and a time clause at Balanced (style guide section 12).

decisions.choice: "ang tao", "ang mga tao" with no gender span, through Genesis 6
decisions.reason: As in 1:26, Tagalog "tao" means people of either sex, so the English spans "humankind|man" and "people|men" have no Tagalog counterpart (style guide section 8). Where the English span changes "they" to "he", Tagalog has "sila|siya" (verse 3).

source.text: וַיִּרְא֤וּ בְנֵי־הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֥י טֹבֹ֖ת הֵ֑נָּה וַיִּקְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ נָשִׁ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּחָֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw [the] sons of God the daughters of humankind, that good they [were], and they took for themselves wives from all whom they chose.

en.L: that the sons of God saw that the daughters of {{gender:humankind|man}} [were] beautiful, and they took for themselves wives from all whom they chose.
en.B: the sons of God saw that the daughters of {{gender:humans|men}} were beautiful, and they married any of them they chose.
en.R: The sons of God saw that these daughters were beautiful, and they took as wives any of them they wanted.

es.L: los hijos de Dios vieron que las hijas {{gender:de la humanidad|del hombre}} [eran] hermosas, y tomaron para sí mujeres de entre todas las que escogieron.
es.B: los hijos de Dios vieron que las hijas de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} eran hermosas, y tomaron como esposas a cuantas eligieron.
es.R: Los hijos de Dios vieron que esas hijas eran hermosas, y se casaron con las que quisieron.

fr.L: que les fils de Dieu virent que les filles {{gender:de l’humanité|de l’homme}} [étaient] belles, et ils prirent pour eux des femmes parmi toutes celles qu’ils choisirent.
fr.B: les fils de Dieu virent que les filles {{gender:des humains|des hommes}} étaient belles, et ils épousèrent toutes celles qu’ils choisirent.
fr.R: Les fils de Dieu ont vu que ces filles étaient belles, et ils ont pris pour femmes toutes celles qu’ils voulaient.

sw.L: wana wa Mungu wakaona kwamba binti za wanadamu [walikuwa] wazuri, wakajitwalia wake kutoka kwa wote waliowachagua.
sw.B: wana wa Mungu waliona kwamba binti za wanadamu walikuwa wazuri, wakaoa yeyote kati yao waliyemchagua.
sw.R: Wana wa Mungu waliona kwamba binti hao walikuwa wazuri, wakawaoa wale wote waliowataka.

vi.L: thì các con trai của Đức Chúa Trời thấy các con gái của loài người [thì] xinh đẹp, và họ cưới cho mình những người vợ trong số tất cả những người họ chọn.
vi.B: các con trai của Đức Chúa Trời thấy các con gái của loài người xinh đẹp, nên họ cưới bất cứ ai trong số những người ấy mà họ chọn.
vi.R: Các con trai của Đức Chúa Trời thấy những con gái ấy xinh đẹp, nên họ lấy làm vợ bất cứ ai họ muốn.

ko.L: 하나님의 아들들이 사람의 딸들을 보니 아름다웠다. 그래서 그들은 자기들이 고른 모든 [여자] 가운데서 자기들을 위해 아내를 맞았다.
ko.B: 하나님의 아들들이 사람의 딸들이 아름다운 것을 보고, 자기들이 고른 여자는 누구든지 아내로 삼았다.
ko.R: 하나님의 아들들은 그 딸들이 아름다운 것을 보았다. 그래서 그들은 마음에 드는 여자를 누구든지 아내로 삼았다.

pt.L: que os filhos de Deus viram que as filhas {{gender:da humanidade|dos homens}} [eram] belas, e tomaram para si mulheres de todas as que escolheram.
pt.B: os filhos de Deus viram que as filhas {{gender:dos seres humanos|dos homens}} eram bonitas e se casaram com as que escolheram.
pt.R: Os filhos de Deus viram que essas filhas eram bonitas e tomaram como esposas as que quiseram.

am.L: የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች የሰውን ሴቶች ልጆች ውብ መሆናቸውን አዩ፤ ከመረጡአቸውም ሁሉ ሚስቶችን ለራሳቸው ወሰዱ።
am.B: የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች የሰዎች ሴቶች ልጆች ውብ መሆናቸውን አዩ፤ ከእነርሱም የመረጡትን ሁሉ አገቡ።
am.R: የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች እነዚህ ሴቶች ልጆች ውብ መሆናቸውን አዩ፤ ከእነርሱም የፈለጉትን ሁሉ ሚስቶች አድርገው ወሰዱ።

hi.L: कि परमेश्वर के पुत्रों ने मनुष्यों की बेटियों को देखा कि वे सुंदर [हैं], और उन्होंने उन सब में से जिन्हें उन्होंने चुना, अपने लिए पत्नियाँ ले लीं।
hi.B: तब परमेश्वर के पुत्रों ने देखा कि मनुष्यों की बेटियाँ सुंदर हैं, और उनमें से जिस-जिस को उन्होंने चुना, उससे विवाह कर लिया।
hi.R: परमेश्वर के पुत्रों ने देखा कि ये बेटियाँ सुंदर हैं, और उनमें से जिसे वे चाहते थे, उसे पत्नी बना लिया।

ru.L: что сыны Божьи увидели, что дочери человеческие красивы, и брали себе в жёны всех, кого выбирали.
ru.B: сыны Божьи увидели, что дочери людей красивы, и брали в жёны любых из них, каких выбирали.
ru.R: Сыновья Бога увидели, что эти дочери красивы, и брали себе в жёны любых, каких хотели.

uk.L: що сини Божі побачили, що дочки людей гарні, і брали собі жінок з-поміж усіх, кого вибирали.
uk.B: сини Божі побачили, що людські дочки вродливі, і брали собі за дружин тих, кого хотіли.
uk.R: Сини Бога побачили, що ці дочки вродливі, і брали собі за дружин тих, кого хотіли.

ja.L: 神の子らは、人の娘たちが美しいのを見た。そして彼らは、自分が選んだすべての者の中から、自分のために妻をめとった。
ja.B: 神の子らは、人の娘たちが美しいのを見て、その中から好きな者を選んで妻とした。
ja.R: 神の子たちは、その娘たちが美しいのを見て、だれでも好きな者を妻にしました。

id.L: bahwa anak-anak Allah melihat bahwa anak-anak perempuan manusia itu cantik, dan mereka mengambil bagi diri mereka istri dari semua yang mereka pilih.
id.B: anak-anak Allah melihat bahwa anak-anak perempuan manusia itu cantik, lalu mereka mengawini siapa saja yang mereka pilih.
id.R: Anak-anak Allah melihat bahwa anak-anak perempuan itu cantik, lalu mereka mengambil siapa saja yang mereka inginkan menjadi istri mereka.

zh.L: {{god_term:神|上帝}}的众子看见人的女儿们是好看的，就从他们所选中的一切[女子]中，为自己娶了妻子。
zh.B: {{god_term:神|上帝}}的众子看见人的女儿们很美，就娶了他们所选中的任何一个。
zh.R: {{god_term:神|上帝}}的众子看到这些女儿很美丽，就随意娶她们中任何想要的人作妻子。

tl.L: na nakita ng mga anak ng Diyos na ang mga anak na babae ng tao ay magaganda, at kumuha sila para sa kanilang sarili ng mga asawa mula sa lahat ng kanilang pinili.
tl.B: nakita ng mga anak ng Diyos na magaganda ang mga anak na babae ng mga tao, at napangasawa nila ang sinumang kanilang piliin.
tl.R: Nakita ng mga anak ng Diyos na magaganda ang mga anak na babaing ito, at kinuha nila bilang asawa ang sinuman sa kanila na kanilang gustuhin.

decisions.choice: the sons of God: heavenly beings, most likely
alternatives: men of the godly line of Seth
decisions.reason: Elsewhere in the Old Testament "sons of God" names heavenly beings who serve God (Job 1:6; 2:1; 38:7; compare Psalm 29:1). Ancient Jewish writings and early Christian writers read the verse this way, and 1 Peter 3:19-20 and Jude 6 may allude to it. Others take the sons of God as the men of Seth's line marrying into Cain's, or as kings who claimed divine descent and took any women they wished. The text does not explain further.

decisions.choice: saw that they were good ... took: the pattern of 3:6
decisions.reason: The words echo 3:6, where the woman saw that the tree was good and took. Here too, seeing, desiring and taking cross a line God has set.

decisions.choice: beautiful
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is "good", which here means good-looking; the echo of 3:6 (m2) is noted in the decision.

decisions.choice: "các con trai của Đức Chúa Trời"
decisions.reason: The phrase is kept as it stands at every level, as in the English, since who they were is uncertain (m1).

decisions.choice: "परमेश्वर के पुत्र" (the sons of God)
decisions.reason: Most likely heavenly beings (m1), not God's people, so the phrase is kept as it stands and has no gender span; "सन्तान" would suggest human children of God.

decisions.choice: "сыны Божьи" (L, B); "сыновья Бога" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew phrase most likely means heavenly beings (m1), but it is kept as it stands so that the reader can weigh it; "Божьи", not "Божии", as the Russian New Testament writes it.

decisions.choice: "神の子ら" (L, B), "神の子たち" (R), with no explanation in the text
decisions.reason: The phrase most likely means heavenly beings, but this is uncertain (m1); Japanese keeps the phrase as the English does and leaves the sense to the footnote.

decisions.choice: "anak-anak Allah" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew phrase most likely means heavenly beings, though this is uncertain (m1); Indonesian keeps the phrase as the English does and leaves the meaning to the note.

decisions.choice: {{god_term:神|上帝}} for every word naming God
decisions.reason: The Chinese reader setting (style guide section 4); this note stands for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: "{{god_term:神|上帝}}的众子"
decisions.reason: Most likely heavenly beings (meaning decision m1), but every English level keeps "the sons of God", so Chinese keeps the phrase too, in the glossary's form for Job; "众子" marks a class of beings rather than God's own children. "好看" (L) is the Hebrew "good" in the sense good-looking, the pattern of 3:6 (m2).

decisions.choice: "mga anak ng Diyos" (sons of God) with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "sons of God" are heavenly beings (m1); "mga anak" here means "sons" in context, and adding "na lalaki" would make a phrase the source does not have. The phrase is kept the same in verse 4 and in Job 1:6.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה לֹֽא־יָד֨וֹן רוּחִ֤י בָֽאָדָם֙ לְעֹלָ֔ם בְּשַׁגַּ֖ם ה֣וּא בָשָׂ֑ר וְהָי֣וּ יָמָ֔יו מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said YHWH, not will remain my spirit in humankind forever, since also he [is] flesh; and will be his days a hundred and twenty years.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "My spirit will not remain in {{gender:humankind|man}} forever, for {{gender:they are|he is}} indeed flesh; and {{gender:their|his}} days will be 120 years."
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "My spirit will not stay in {{gender:human beings|man}} forever, for they are mortal. Their days will be 120 years."
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "I will not let {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} breath of life stay in people forever. They are only human. They will live no more than 120 years."

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: «No permanecerá {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} espíritu en {{gender:los seres humanos|el hombre}} para siempre, porque ciertamente {{gender:ellos son|él es}} carne; y sus días serán 120 años».
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «Mi espíritu no permanecerá para siempre en {{gender:los seres humanos|el hombre}}, porque {{gender:son mortales|es mortal}}. Sus días serán 120 años».
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «No dejaré que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} aliento de vida se quede para siempre en la gente. No son más que seres humanos. No vivirán más de 120 años».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « Mon esprit ne demeurera pas dans {{gender:l’humanité|l’homme}} pour toujours, car {{gender:elle|il}} est bien chair ; et ses jours seront de 120 ans. »
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « Mon esprit ne restera pas pour toujours dans {{gender:les êtres humains, car ils sont mortels. Leurs jours seront|l’homme, car il est mortel. Ses jours seront}} de 120 ans. »
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : « Je ne laisserai pas {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} souffle de vie rester pour toujours dans les gens. Ils ne sont que des humains. Ils ne vivront pas plus de 120 ans. »

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Roho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} haitakaa ndani ya wanadamu milele, kwa maana wao pia ni mwili; na siku zao zitakuwa miaka 120."
sw.B: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Roho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} haitakaa ndani ya wanadamu milele, kwa kuwa wao ni wa kufa. Siku zao zitakuwa miaka 120."
sw.R: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Sitaiacha pumzi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ya uhai ikae ndani ya watu milele. Wao ni binadamu tu. Hawataishi zaidi ya miaka 120."

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Thần của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không ở lại trong loài người mãi mãi, vì họ cũng chỉ là xác thịt; và các ngày của họ sẽ là 120 năm."
vi.B: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Thần của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không ở lại trong loài người mãi mãi, vì họ là loài phải chết. Đời họ sẽ chỉ là 120 năm."
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Ta sẽ không để hơi thở sự sống của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở lại trong loài người mãi mãi. Họ chỉ là con người. Họ sẽ sống không quá 120 năm."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "내 영이 사람 안에 영원히 머물지 않을 것이다. 그들은 참으로 육체이기 때문이다. 그들의 날은 120년이 될 것이다."
ko.B: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "내 영이 사람 안에 영원히 머물지는 않을 것이다. 그들은 죽을 몸이기 때문이다. 그들의 날은 120년이 될 것이다."
ko.R: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "내가 준 생명의 숨이 사람 안에 영원히 머물게 하지 않겠다. 그들은 사람일 뿐이다. 그들은 120년보다 더 오래 살지 못할 것이다."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} espírito não permanecerá {{gender:na humanidade|no homem}} para sempre, pois {{gender:ela|ele}} é de fato carne; e os seus dias serão cento e vinte anos."
pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} espírito não ficará {{gender:nos seres humanos|no homem}} para sempre, pois eles são mortais. Os dias deles serão cento e vinte anos."
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Não vou deixar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} sopro de vida ficar nas pessoas para sempre. Elas não passam de seres humanos. Não vão viver mais de cento e vinte anos."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም አለ፦ «መንፈሴ በሰው ውስጥ ለዘላለም አይኖርም፤ እርሱ ሥጋ ነውና፤ ዘመኑም 120 ዓመት ይሆናል።»
am.B: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} «መንፈሴ በሰው ውስጥ ለዘላለም አይኖርም፤ ሟቾች ናቸውና። ዘመናቸው 120 ዓመት ይሆናል» አለ።
am.R: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለ፦ «የሕይወት እስትንፋሴ በሰዎች ውስጥ ለዘላለም እንዲኖር አልፈቅድም። እነርሱ ሟች ሰዎች ብቻ ናቸው። ከ120 ዓመት በላይ አይኖሩም።»

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा, "मेरा आत्मा सदा तक मनुष्य में बना न रहेगा, क्योंकि वह भी शरीर ही [है]; और उसके दिन एक सौ बीस वर्ष होंगे।"
hi.B: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा, "मेरा आत्मा सदा तक मनुष्य में न रहेगा, क्योंकि वे नश्वर हैं। उनके दिन एक सौ बीस वर्ष होंगे।"
hi.R: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा, "मैं अपना जीवन का श्वास लोगों में सदा तक रहने न दूँगा। वे तो बस इंसान हैं। वे एक सौ बीस साल से ज़्यादा नहीं जीएँगे।"

ru.L: И {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал: «Мой дух не будет пребывать в человеке вечно, ведь он — плоть; и его дней будет 120 лет.»
ru.B: Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал: «Мой дух не будет вечно оставаться в людях, потому что они смертны. Их дней будет 120 лет.»
ru.R: Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал: «Я не позволю {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} дыханию жизни вечно оставаться в людях. Они всего лишь люди. Они будут жить не больше 120 лет.»

uk.L: І сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: «Не перебуватиме {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} дух у людині повіки, бо вона ж — плоть; і будуть її дні — 120 років.»
uk.B: Тоді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав: «Мій дух не залишатиметься в людях вічно, бо вони смертні. Їхніх днів буде 120 років.»
uk.R: Тоді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав: «Я не дозволю, щоб {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} подих життя залишався в людях вічно. Вони лише люди. Вони житимуть не більше як 120 років.»

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言われた。「わたしの霊は、永遠に人のうちにとどまることはない。人はまさしく肉だからである。人の日々は百二十年となる。」
ja.B: そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言われた。「わたしの霊は、いつまでも人のうちにとどまりはしない。人は死ぬべき者だからである。人の生きる日は百二十年となる。」
ja.R: そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言われました。「わたしは、わたしの命の息を、いつまでも人の中にとどめてはおかない。人はただの人間にすぎない。人は百二十年より長くは生きない。」

id.L: Dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman, "Roh-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} tidak akan tinggal di dalam manusia untuk selama-lamanya, karena mereka memang daging; dan umur mereka akan 120 tahun."
id.B: Kemudian {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman, "Roh-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} tidak akan tinggal di dalam manusia untuk selama-lamanya, karena mereka fana. Umur mereka akan 120 tahun."
id.R: Lalu {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman, "Aku tidak akan membiarkan napas hidup dari-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} tinggal di dalam manusia untuk selama-lamanya. Mereka hanyalah manusia. Mereka tidak akan hidup lebih dari 120 tahun."

zh.L: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}说：“我的灵不会永远留在人里面，因为{{gender:他们|他}}也是肉体；{{gender:他们|他}}的日子要是一百二十年。”
zh.B: 然后{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}说：“我的灵不会永远留在人里面，因为他们是必死的。他们的日子将是一百二十年。”
zh.R: 然后{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}说：“我不会让我赐的生命气息永远留在人里面。他们只不过是人。他们最多只能活一百二十年。”

tl.L: At sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, "Hindi mananatili ang aking espiritu sa tao magpakailanman, sapagkat {{gender:sila|siya}} ay laman nga; at ang {{gender:kanilang|kaniyang}} mga araw ay magiging 120 taon."
tl.B: Pagkatapos ay sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, "Hindi mananatili ang aking espiritu sa tao magpakailanman, sapagkat sila ay may kamatayan. Ang kanilang mga araw ay magiging 120 taon."
tl.R: Pagkatapos ay sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, "Hindi ko hahayaang manatili sa mga tao magpakailanman ang hiningang bigay ko. Mga tao lamang sila. Hindi sila mabubuhay nang higit sa 120 taon."

decisions.choice: remain: stay, abide
decisions.reason: The verb occurs only here, and its meaning is uncertain. The ancient translations read "remain" or "abide", which fits the setting: the life-giving spirit God breathed into humankind (2:7) will not stay in them for ever. Others link it to a verb meaning "judge" or "contend".

decisions.choice: my spirit: the breath of life God gives
alternatives: the Holy Spirit striving with sinners
decisions.reason: The word means breath, wind or spirit. Here it is most likely the breath of life that God gives and can take away (2:7; 6:17; Psalm 104:29-30).

decisions.choice: his days will be 120 years: a limit on human life, or the time left before the flood
alternatives: a limit on the length of a human life
decisions.reason: The words can set the length of a human life (and lifespans do fall after the flood, toward this limit and below it: 11:10-32; Deuteronomy 34:7), or the time God allows before the flood. Both readings are old.

decisions.choice: they are mortal (B); They are only human (R)
decisions.reason: "Flesh" here means mortal, weak human nature (Psalm 78:39; Isaiah 40:6). Literal keeps "flesh".

decisions.choice: my (deity pronoun setting at Readable); My at the start of a sentence
decisions.reason: God speaks of himself, so "my" takes the deity pronoun setting; at the start of a sentence (Literal, Balanced) it is capitalised either way.

decisions.choice: "el SEÑOR" (default); with the divine name setting, "Yahvé"
decisions.reason: As in English, the name YHWH is "el SEÑOR" in small capitals by default, after the long tradition of reading "Lord" for the name; the setting gives the name itself in its usual modern Spanish form, "Yahvé". "Jehová" is a later hybrid form; plain "el Señor" would hide that a name stands here. The span takes in the article and any contraction ("del SEÑOR" / "de Yahvé", "al SEÑOR" / "a Yahvé"). This holds through the chapter.

decisions.choice: mi (deity pronoun setting)
decisions.reason: Spanish word order puts God's "my" inside the sentence at Literal ("No permanecerá mi espíritu") and Readable, so it takes the deity pronoun setting there; at Balanced it opens the sentence and is capitalised either way.

decisions.choice: {{gender:les êtres humains, car ils sont mortels. Leurs jours seront|l’homme, car il est mortel. Ses jours seront}}
decisions.reason: The pronoun, the adjective and the possessive all agree with the noun, so Balanced puts the whole stretch under one gender span, and each option reads as correct French.

decisions.choice: roho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} (L, B); pumzi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ya uhai (R)
decisions.reason: The word means breath or spirit, here the breath of life God gives (m2), so it is written "roho" in lowercase, not as the Holy Spirit; Readable says "pumzi ya uhai", as the English Readable says "breath of life". The free possessive "yangu" takes the deity pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "Thần của Ta" (L, B), "hơi thở sự sống của Ta" (R)
decisions.reason: God's spirit here is the breath of life he gives (m2), so the capitalised "Thần Linh" of 1:2 is not used; Readable says "breath of life", as the English Readable does. The Hebrew "they" is "họ", which already takes in men and women, so no gender span is needed.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ela|ele}}
decisions.reason: The English Literal needs "they are" for its inclusive default; Portuguese "a humanidade" is singular, so Literal keeps the Hebrew singular, "ela é carne", and the gender setting gives "ele é carne" with "o homem", as in 1:27.

decisions.choice: o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}}
decisions.reason: In Portuguese the article comes first, so "meu" is not at the start of the sentence and takes the deity pronoun setting at every level.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; "अपना", "मेरा" in God's own words
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi. Respect for God comes from the honorific third person at every level (style guide, section 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "शरीर" (flesh)
decisions.reason: "शरीर" is the translation's word for flesh as mortal human nature, as in Romans; Balanced and Readable say mortal, only human, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "人" with no gender span for the English humankind / they / their spans; "肉" (L), "死ぬべき者" (B), "ただの人間" (R) for flesh
decisions.reason: Japanese 人 covers men and women, and the pronouns are repeated as 人, so no setting is needed. Flesh here means mortal, as the English Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "Roh-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}" (L, B); "napas hidup dari-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}" (R)
decisions.reason: The spirit here is the breath of life God gives (m2); Literal and Balanced keep "roh" with the span on God's "-Ku", and Readable says breath of life as the English Readable does. "mereka" for the Hebrew "he" needs no gender span.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}; "我的" with no deity pronoun span
decisions.reason: The divine name setting as in chapters 2-4 (style guide section 4). The English spans God's "my" here and in verses 13, 17 and 18; Chinese has no reverent first person, so God speaking says plain "我". Literal mirrors the English gender spans on the Hebrew singular with {{gender:他们|他}}.

decisions.choice: "肉体" (L); "必死的" (B); "只不过是人" (R)
decisions.reason: "Flesh" here is mortal, weak human nature; Literal keeps the word, Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: "ang aking espiritu" (my spirit) at Literal and Balanced, lowercase; "ang hiningang bigay ko" (the breath I give) at Readable
decisions.reason: The spirit here is the breath of life God gives (m2), not the Holy Spirit, so "espiritu" is lowercase, as the English writes "spirit". The English Readable puts a span on "my"; Tagalog "ko" and "aking" for God take none (style guide section 4).

source.text: הַנְּפִלִ֞ים הָי֣וּ בָאָרֶץ֮ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֒ וְגַ֣ם אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבֹ֜אוּ בְּנֵ֤י הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְיָלְד֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם הֵ֧מָּה הַגִּבֹּרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֵעוֹלָ֖ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַשֵּֽׁם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when went in [the] sons of God to [the] daughters of humankind and they bore to them; they [were] the mighty men who [were] from of old, [the] men of the name.

en.L: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God went in to the daughters of {{gender:humankind|man}} and they bore [children] to them. They [were] the mighty men who [were] of old, the men of renown.
en.B: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God had relations with the daughters of {{gender:humans|men}} and they bore them children. These were the mighty men of old, the famous men.
en.R: In those days, and later too, there were giants on the earth called Nephilim. At that time the sons of God had children with the daughters of people. Those children grew up to be the famous heroes of long ago.

es.L: Los nefilim estaban en la tierra en aquellos días, y también después, cuando los hijos de Dios se unieron a las hijas {{gender:de la humanidad|del hombre}} y ellas les dieron [hijos]. Ellos [fueron] los valientes que [hubo] en la antigüedad, los hombres de renombre.
es.B: En aquellos días había nefilim en la tierra, y también después, cuando los hijos de Dios tuvieron relaciones con las hijas de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} y ellas les dieron hijos. Estos fueron los héroes de la antigüedad, hombres famosos.
es.R: En aquellos tiempos, y también más tarde, había en la tierra unos gigantes llamados nefilim. En esa época los hijos de Dios tuvieron hijos con las hijas de la gente. Esos hijos llegaron a ser los héroes famosos de tiempos antiguos.

fr.L: Les Néphilim étaient sur la terre en ces jours-là, et aussi après, quand les fils de Dieu allèrent vers les filles {{gender:de l’humanité|de l’homme}} et qu’elles leur enfantèrent [des enfants]. Ce [sont] les héros qui [furent] d’autrefois, les hommes de renom.
fr.B: Les Néphilim étaient sur la terre en ces jours-là, et aussi plus tard, lorsque les fils de Dieu s’unirent aux filles {{gender:des humains|des hommes}} et qu’elles leur donnèrent des enfants. Ce furent les héros d’autrefois, les hommes célèbres.
fr.R: À cette époque, et plus tard aussi, il y avait sur la terre des géants appelés Néphilim. En ce temps-là, les fils de Dieu ont eu des enfants avec les filles des humains. Ces enfants sont devenus les héros célèbres d’autrefois.

sw.L: Wanefili walikuwako duniani siku zile, na pia baadaye, wana wa Mungu walipoingia kwa binti za wanadamu, nao wakawazalia [watoto]. Hao [ndio] mashujaa waliokuwako tangu zamani, watu wenye jina.
sw.B: Wanefili walikuwa duniani siku zile, na pia baadaye, wana wa Mungu walipolala na binti za wanadamu, nao wakawazalia watoto. Hao ndio mashujaa wa zamani, watu maarufu.
sw.R: Siku zile, na hata baadaye, kulikuwa na majitu duniani walioitwa Wanefili. Wakati huo wana wa Mungu walipata watoto na binti za watu. Watoto hao walikua wakawa mashujaa maarufu wa zamani.

vi.L: Người Nê-phi-lim ở trên đất trong những ngày ấy, và cũng về sau, khi các con trai của Đức Chúa Trời đi đến với các con gái của loài người và họ sinh [con] cho họ. Những người ấy [là] các dũng sĩ thời xưa, những người có danh tiếng.
vi.B: Người Nê-phi-lim ở trên đất trong những ngày ấy, và cả về sau nữa, khi các con trai của Đức Chúa Trời ăn ở với các con gái của loài người và các nàng sinh con cho họ. Đó là các dũng sĩ thời xưa, những người nổi danh.
vi.R: Trong những ngày ấy, và cả về sau nữa, trên đất có những người khổng lồ gọi là Nê-phi-lim. Lúc đó các con trai của Đức Chúa Trời có con với các con gái của loài người. Những đứa con ấy lớn lên trở thành những anh hùng nổi tiếng thời xưa.

ko.L: 그 날들에, 그리고 그 뒤에도, 땅에는 네피림이 있었다. 그때는 하나님의 아들들이 사람의 딸들에게 들어가 그들이 그들에게 [자식을] 낳아 주던 때였다. 그들은 옛날부터 있던 용사들, 이름난 사람들이었다.
ko.B: 그 무렵에, 그리고 그 뒤에도, 땅에는 네피림이 있었다. 그때 하나님의 아들들이 사람의 딸들과 관계하여 그 딸들이 그들에게 자식을 낳아 주었다. 그들은 옛날의 용사들, 이름난 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 그 무렵에, 그리고 그 뒤에도, 땅에는 네피림이라는 거인들이 있었다. 그때 하나님의 아들들이 사람의 딸들과 함께 자식을 낳았다. 그 자식들은 자라서 옛날의 이름난 영웅들이 되었다.

pt.L: Os nefilins estavam na terra naqueles dias, e também depois disso, quando os filhos de Deus se uniam às filhas {{gender:da humanidade|dos homens}} e elas lhes davam [filhos]. Eles [eram] os valentes que [houve] desde a antiguidade, os homens de renome.
pt.B: Os nefilins estavam na terra naqueles dias, e também depois, quando os filhos de Deus tiveram relações com as filhas {{gender:dos seres humanos|dos homens}} e elas lhes deram filhos. Esses foram os heróis da antiguidade, os homens famosos.
pt.R: Naqueles dias, e também mais tarde, havia na terra gigantes chamados nefilins. Naquele tempo, os filhos de Deus tiveram filhos com as filhas dos seres humanos. Esses filhos se tornaram os heróis famosos de muito tempo atrás.

am.L: በዚያ ዘመን፣ ከዚያም በኋላ ደግሞ፣ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ወደ ሰው ሴቶች ልጆች በገቡና [ልጆችን] በወለዱላቸው ጊዜ፣ ኔፍሊም በምድር ላይ ነበሩ። እነርሱ ከጥንት ጀምሮ የነበሩ ኃያላን፣ ስመ ጥር ሰዎች [ነበሩ]።
am.B: በዚያ ዘመን፣ ከዚያም በኋላ ደግሞ፣ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ከሰዎች ሴቶች ልጆች ጋር በተኙና ልጆችን በወለዱላቸው ጊዜ፣ ኔፍሊም በምድር ላይ ነበሩ። እነዚህ የጥንት ኃያላን፣ ዝነኞቹ ሰዎች ነበሩ።
am.R: በዚያ ዘመን፣ በኋላም ደግሞ፣ ኔፍሊም የሚባሉ ግዙፍ ሰዎች በምድር ላይ ነበሩ። በዚያን ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ከሰዎች ሴቶች ልጆች ጋር ልጆችን ወለዱ። እነዚያ ልጆች አድገው የጥንት ዝነኛ ጀግኖች ሆኑ።

hi.L: उन दिनों में, और उसके बाद भी, पृथ्वी पर नपीली थे, जब परमेश्वर के पुत्र मनुष्यों की बेटियों के पास गए और उन्होंने उनके लिए [सन्तान] जनी। ये वही शूरवीर थे जो प्राचीन काल से [थे], नामी पुरुष।
hi.B: उन दिनों में, और उसके बाद भी, पृथ्वी पर नपीली थे, जब परमेश्वर के पुत्रों ने मनुष्यों की बेटियों से संबंध रखे और उनसे उनके बच्चे हुए। ये प्राचीन काल के शूरवीर, प्रसिद्ध पुरुष थे।
hi.R: उन दिनों में, और बाद में भी, धरती पर नपीली कहलानेवाले बहुत बड़े डील-डौल के लोग थे। उस समय परमेश्वर के पुत्रों के लोगों की बेटियों से बच्चे हुए। वे बच्चे बड़े होकर पुराने ज़माने के मशहूर वीर बने।

ru.L: Нефилимы были на земле в те дни, и также после того, когда сыны Божьи входили к дочерям человеческим и те рожали им. Это были богатыри, которые [были] издревле, прославленные люди.
ru.B: Нефилимы были на земле в те дни и также после, когда сыны Божьи сходились с дочерьми людей и те рожали им детей. Это были богатыри древности, прославленные люди.
ru.R: В те дни, и позже тоже, на земле были великаны, которых называли нефилимами. В то время сыновья Бога имели детей от дочерей людей. Эти дети выросли и стали знаменитыми героями далёкого прошлого.

uk.L: Нефілими були на землі в ті дні, а також і потім, коли сини Божі входили до дочок людей, і ті народжували їм [дітей]. Це [були] могутні мужі, що [були] віддавна, мужі слави.
uk.B: Нефілими були на землі в ті дні, а також згодом, коли сини Божі сходилися з дочками людей і ті народжували їм дітей. Це були могутні мужі давнини, славетні люди.
uk.R: У ті дні, а також пізніше, на землі жили велетні, яких називали нефілимами. Тоді сини Бога мали дітей від людських дочок. Ці діти виросли й стали славними героями давніх часів.

ja.L: そのころ、またその後にも、地上にはネフィリムがいた。神の子らが人の娘たちのところに入り、彼女たちが彼らに[子を]産んだときである。彼らは昔からの勇士たち、名のある者たちであった。
ja.B: そのころ、またその後にも、地上にはネフィリムがいた。神の子らが人の娘たちと交わり、彼女たちが子を産んだころのことである。彼らは昔の勇士たち、名高い者たちであった。
ja.R: そのころ、またその後にも、地上にはネフィリムと呼ばれる大男たちがいました。そのころ、神の子たちが人の娘たちとの間に子どもをもうけました。その子どもたちは成長して、昔の有名な英雄たちになりました。

id.L: Orang-orang Nefilim ada di bumi pada masa itu, dan juga sesudahnya, ketika anak-anak Allah menghampiri anak-anak perempuan manusia, dan mereka melahirkan [anak-anak] bagi mereka. Merekalah orang-orang perkasa pada zaman dahulu, orang-orang yang termasyhur.
id.B: Orang-orang Nefilim ada di bumi pada masa itu, dan juga sesudahnya, ketika anak-anak Allah berhubungan dengan anak-anak perempuan manusia, dan perempuan-perempuan itu melahirkan anak-anak bagi mereka. Merekalah orang-orang perkasa pada zaman dahulu, orang-orang yang terkenal.
id.R: Pada masa itu, dan juga sesudahnya, ada raksasa di bumi yang disebut Nefilim. Pada waktu itu anak-anak Allah mendapat anak dari anak-anak perempuan manusia. Anak-anak itu menjadi pahlawan-pahlawan terkenal pada zaman dahulu.

zh.L: 那些日子，以及后来，拿非利人在地上，就是{{god_term:神|上帝}}的众子进到人的女儿们那里，她们为他们生[孩子]的时候。他们就是古时的勇士，是有名的人。
zh.B: 在那些日子，以及后来，地上有拿非利人；那时{{god_term:神|上帝}}的众子与人的女儿们同房，她们为他们生了孩子。这些人就是古时的勇士，是有名望的人。
zh.R: 在那些日子，以及后来，地上有巨人，叫作拿非利人。那时，{{god_term:神|上帝}}的众子和人的女儿们生了孩子。这些孩子长大后，成了古时有名的英雄。

tl.L: Ang mga Nefilim ay nasa lupa nang mga araw na iyon, at pagkatapos din nito, nang sipingan ng mga anak ng Diyos ang mga anak na babae ng tao at nanganak sila [ng mga anak] para sa kanila. Sila ang mga makapangyarihang lalaki noong unang panahon, ang mga lalaking bantog.
tl.B: Ang mga Nefilim ay nasa lupa nang mga araw na iyon, at pagkatapos din nito, nang sipingan ng mga anak ng Diyos ang mga anak na babae ng mga tao at nagkaanak sila sa kanila. Sila ang mga makapangyarihang lalaki noong unang panahon, ang mga bantog na lalaki.
tl.R: Nang mga araw na iyon, at pagkatapos din nito, may mga higanteng tinatawag na Nefilim sa lupa. Nang panahong iyon ay nagkaanak ang mga anak ng Diyos sa mga anak na babae ng mga tao. Lumaki ang mga batang iyon at naging mga bantog na bayani noong unang panahon.

decisions.choice: Nephilim: a people of great size and strength, left untranslated
decisions.reason: The word may come from the verb "to fall", but its meaning is not certain. Numbers 13:33 uses it for people of great size in Canaan, and the Septuagint translates it "giants". The verse does not say that the Nephilim were the children of the sons of God; it says they were on the earth at that time.

decisions.choice: the mighty men of old, the men of renown: famous warriors of the ancient past
decisions.reason: "Mighty men" are warriors and heroes (10:8-9). "Men of the name" means men with a great reputation. The next verses show what the world of such heroes had become.

decisions.choice: and also afterward: Nephilim were known after the flood too
decisions.reason: The words prepare for Numbers 13:33, where the Nephilim appear again in Canaan.

decisions.choice: giants ... called Nephilim
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name, following the Septuagint and Numbers 13:33 (m1).

decisions.choice: los nefilim (lower case)
decisions.reason: The word is left untranslated, as in English (m1), in its usual Spanish transcription. Spanish writes the names of peoples and kinds of beings in lower case ("los cananeos", "los querubines"), so "nefilim" is not capitalised. Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: se unieron a
decisions.reason: The Hebrew idiom "go in to" a woman means to have sexual relations. A word-for-word "entraron a" does not carry that sense in Spanish, and "se llegaron a" is archaic, so Literal uses "se unieron a"; Balanced says it plainly, as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: les Néphilim
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is kept as a name, as the English does (m1), with the French accent; Readable explains it as "des géants", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Wanefili
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is kept as the name of a people, with the Swahili plural prefix "Wa-"; Readable explains it as "majitu" (giants), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Nê-phi-lim", with "người khổng lồ" added at R
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is kept, as in the English; Readable says they were giants, with the uncertainty of the English choice.

decisions.choice: os nefilins
decisions.reason: The word is left untranslated (m1), in the form Portuguese gives it, with the Portuguese plural; "gigantes", the Septuagint's reading, is kept for Readable, as the English Readable says "giants".

decisions.choice: "ኔፍሊም" (Nephilim), the Hebrew name, at every level; Readable adds "ግዙፍ ሰዎች" (giants)
decisions.reason: The word names a people of great size and strength (meaning decision m1), and it is left as a name, as the English does; Readable explains it once. The Literal word order puts "the Nephilim were on the earth" after the time clauses, since Amharic ends with its main verb; each verse's content is unchanged.

decisions.choice: "नपीली" (Nephilim); "बहुत बड़े डील-डौल के लोग" (R)
decisions.reason: A people of great size and strength, left untranslated (m1). "दानव" and "दैत्य" are demons and giants of Hindu story, so Hindi keeps the Hebrew name and Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: "нефилимы"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is kept, as in the English (m1). "Исполины", the traditional word, comes from the Greek translation and decides that they were giants; Readable says so and gives the name.

decisions.choice: "нефілими", left as a name, with Readable saying they were giants
decisions.reason: The word is left untranslated (meaning decision m1), as in Numbers 13:33; Readable adds what it describes, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ネフィリム" left untranslated, with "大男たち" added at Readable; "勇士たち" (L, B), "英雄たち" (R)
decisions.reason: The Nephilim were a people of great size and strength, and the name is left untranslated as in the English (m1); Readable explains it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Nefilim", left untranslated
decisions.reason: The name is kept as the English keeps it (m1), in the Indonesian spelling with "f"; Readable adds "raksasa" (giants) as the English Readable does. Added to the glossary.

decisions.choice: "拿非利人"; "巨人，叫作拿非利人" (R)
decisions.reason: The Nephilim are a people of great size and strength, left untranslated (meaning decision m1): Chinese keeps the conventional transliteration, and Readable explains it, as the English Readable does. "勇士" is the glossary's word for the mighty men (m2).

decisions.choice: "进到……那里" (L); "同房" (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew's three euphemisms for sexual union, one form each through Genesis: "knew" (yada) "认识" at Literal, as this translation's Matthew 1:25 and Luke 1:34 do; "went in to" (bo el) "进到她那里" at Literal; "lay with" (shakhav im) "同寝" at Literal. Balanced and Readable say it plainly, as the English level does: "有了夫妻关系" where the English says "was intimate with", otherwise "同房" (B, R), with "同寝" or "睡" where the English Balanced or Readable keeps "lay with" or "sleep with".

decisions.choice: "Nefilim" (with "mga higanteng tinatawag na" at Readable); "mga lalaking bantog" (men of renown)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is left untranslated (m1), in the Filipino spelling "Nefilim" (ph > f). Readable explains it, as the English Readable does. "bantog" is famous, renowned (m2).

source.text: וַיַּ֣רְא יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י רַבָּ֛ה רָעַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְכָל־יֵ֨צֶר֙ מַחְשְׁבֹ֣ת לִבּ֔וֹ רַ֥ק רַ֖ע כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw YHWH that great [was] the evil of humankind on the earth, and every inclination of [the] thoughts of his heart [was] only evil all the day.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saw that the wickedness of {{gender:humankind|man}} [was] great on the earth, and every inclination of the thoughts of his heart [was] only evil all the day.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} saw how great the wickedness of {{gender:the human race|man}} had become on the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of their hearts was only evil all the time.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} saw how evil people on earth had become. Everything they thought about and planned was evil all the time.

es.L: Y vio {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que la maldad {{gender:de la humanidad|del hombre}} [era] grande en la tierra, y que toda inclinación de los pensamientos de su corazón [era] solo mal todo el día.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vio cuán grande se había vuelto la maldad {{gender:del género humano|del hombre}} en la tierra, y que toda intención de los pensamientos de su corazón era siempre solamente mala.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vio lo malvada que se había vuelto la gente en la tierra. Todo lo que pensaban y planeaban era malo todo el tiempo.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vit que la méchanceté {{gender:de l’humanité|de l’homme}} [était] grande sur la terre, et que toute inclination des pensées de son cœur [n’était] que mal tout le jour.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vit combien la méchanceté {{gender:du genre humain|de l’homme}} était devenue grande sur la terre, et que toutes les intentions du cœur humain n’étaient que mal, tout le temps.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a vu combien les gens sur la terre étaient devenus mauvais. Tout ce qu’ils pensaient et tout ce qu’ils projetaient était toujours mauvais.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaona kwamba uovu wa wanadamu [ulikuwa] mkubwa duniani, na kila mwelekeo wa mawazo ya moyo wao [ulikuwa] mbaya tu siku yote.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliona jinsi uovu wa wanadamu ulivyokuwa mwingi duniani, na kwamba kila mwelekeo wa mawazo ya mioyo yao ulikuwa mbaya tu wakati wote.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliona jinsi watu duniani walivyokuwa waovu. Kila kitu walichofikiri na kupanga kilikuwa kibaya wakati wote.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thấy sự gian ác của loài người [thì] lớn trên đất, và mọi ý định của tư tưởng trong lòng họ [đều] chỉ là xấu xa suốt ngày.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thấy sự gian ác của loài người trên đất thật lớn, và mọi ý định trong tư tưởng của lòng họ lúc nào cũng chỉ là xấu xa.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thấy loài người trên đất đã trở nên gian ác biết bao. Mọi điều họ suy nghĩ và dự tính lúc nào cũng xấu xa.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보시니 땅에서 사람의 악이 크고, 그 마음의 생각의 모든 의도가 날마다 오직 악하였다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보시니, 땅 위에서 사람의 악이 매우 커졌고, 그들의 마음으로 생각하고 꾀하는 모든 것이 언제나 악할 뿐이었다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보시니, 땅 위의 사람들이 아주 악해져 있었다. 그들이 생각하고 계획하는 것은 언제나 다 악한 것뿐이었다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} viu que a maldade {{gender:da humanidade|do homem}} [era] grande na terra, e que toda inclinação dos pensamentos do seu coração [era] só má o dia todo.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} viu como era grande a maldade {{gender:da raça humana|do homem}} na terra, e que toda inclinação dos pensamentos do coração humano era só má o tempo todo.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} viu como as pessoas na terra tinham se tornado más. Tudo o que elas pensavam e planejavam era mau o tempo todo.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም በምድር ላይ የሰው ክፋት ታላቅ [መሆኑን]፣ የልቡም አሳቦች ዝንባሌ ሁሉ ቀኑን ሙሉ ክፉ ብቻ [መሆኑን] አየ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በምድር ላይ የሰው ዘር ክፋት ምን ያህል እንደ በዛ፣ የልባቸውም አሳብ ዝንባሌ ሁሉ ሁልጊዜ ክፉ ብቻ እንደ ሆነ አየ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በምድር ላይ ሰዎች ምን ያህል ክፉ እንደ ሆኑ አየ። የሚያስቡትና የሚያቅዱት ነገር ሁሉ ሁልጊዜ ክፉ ነበር።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने देखा कि पृथ्वी पर मनुष्य की दुष्टता बड़ी [है], और उसके मन के विचारों की हर एक कल्पना दिन भर केवल बुरी [है]।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने देखा कि पृथ्वी पर मनुष्य जाति की दुष्टता कितनी बढ़ गई है, और उनके मन के विचारों की हर एक कल्पना हर समय केवल बुरी ही होती है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने देखा कि धरती पर लोग कितने बुरे हो गए हैं। वे जो कुछ सोचते और योजना बनाते थे, वह हर समय बुरा ही होता था।

ru.L: И {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} увидел, что велико зло человека на земле, и всякое намерение помыслов его сердца [было] только злым весь день.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} увидел, как велико стало зло людей на земле и что все намерения их сердечных помыслов всё время были только злыми.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} увидел, какими злыми стали люди на земле. Всё, о чём они думали и что задумывали, всё время было злым.

uk.L: І побачив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, що велике зло людини на землі, і всякий задум думок її серця [був] лише злий увесь день.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} побачив, яким великим стало зло людського роду на землі і що всі задуми й думки їхнього серця були постійно лише злі.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} побачив, якими злими стали люди на землі. Усе, про що вони думали й що задумували, завжди було лише злом.

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、地上で人の悪が大きく、その心の思いのすべての傾きが、一日中ただ悪であるのを見られた。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、地上に人の悪がはなはだしくなり、その心に思い計ることがみな、いつもただ悪いことばかりであるのをご覧になった。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、地上の人々がとても悪くなってしまったのをご覧になりました。人々が心に思うことや計画することは、いつも悪いことばかりでした。

id.L: Dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} melihat bahwa kejahatan manusia besar di bumi, dan segala kecenderungan pikiran hatinya hanyalah jahat sepanjang hari.
id.B: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} melihat betapa besarnya kejahatan manusia di bumi, dan bahwa segala kecenderungan pikiran hati mereka selalu hanya jahat.
id.R: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} melihat betapa jahatnya manusia di bumi. Segala sesuatu yang mereka pikirkan dan rencanakan selalu jahat.

zh.L: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}看见人在地上的邪恶很大，并且人心中思想的每一个意念，整天都只是恶的。
zh.B: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}看到人类在地上的罪恶有多大，他们心里所想的一切意念整天都只是恶的。
zh.R: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}看到地上的人变得多么邪恶。他们所想的、所计划的，一直都是坏事。

tl.L: At nakita {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} na malaki ang kasamaan ng tao sa lupa, at ang bawat hilig ng mga isipan ng kaniyang puso ay masama lamang sa buong araw.
tl.B: Nakita {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} kung gaano na kalaki ang kasamaan ng sangkatauhan sa lupa, at na ang bawat hilig ng mga isipan ng kanilang puso ay masama lamang sa lahat ng oras.
tl.R: Nakita {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} kung gaano na kasama ang mga tao sa lupa. Lahat ng kanilang iniisip at binabalak ay masama sa lahat ng oras.

decisions.choice: every inclination of the thoughts of his heart: all that people planned and intended
decisions.reason: "Inclination" is from the verb "form" of 2:7: what the mind shapes or plans. The heart in Hebrew is the center of thought and will, not only of feeling. The verse piles up words, every, only, all the day, to say that evil had filled everything. 8:21 says the same after the flood.

decisions.choice: the LORD saw that great was the evil: the reverse of 1:31
decisions.reason: In 1:31 God saw everything he had made, and it was very good. Now he sees that human evil is great.

decisions.choice: inclinación (L); intención (B)
decisions.reason: The word is what the mind forms or plans (m1). Literal keeps "inclinación" beside the English "inclination"; Balanced says "intención", the plainer word for what someone means to do.

decisions.choice: "कल्पना" (inclination)
decisions.reason: The word is what the mind forms, all that people planned and intended (m1). "कल्पना" is what the mind shapes; Readable says "thought and planned".

decisions.choice: "hilig ng mga isipan ng kaniyang puso" (inclination of the thoughts of his heart); "sangkatauhan" (the human race) at Balanced
decisions.reason: "hilig" is the leaning or bent of the mind (m1). "sangkatauhan" is all humankind, the word for the English Balanced's "the human race", and it is already inclusive.

records.literal_gloss: And regretted YHWH that he had made humankind on the earth, and he was grieved to his heart.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} regretted that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made {{gender:humankind|man}} on the earth, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was grieved to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} heart.
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} regretted that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made {{gender:human beings|man}} on the earth, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} heart was deeply troubled.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was sorry that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made people on the earth. It hurt {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} heart deeply.

es.L: Y lamentó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haber hecho {{gender:a la humanidad|al hombre}} en la tierra, y sintió dolor en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} corazón.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} le pesó haber hecho {{gender:a los seres humanos|al hombre}} en la tierra, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} corazón se llenó de dolor.
es.R: {{divine_name:Al SEÑOR|A Yahvé}} le dio mucha tristeza haber hecho a la gente en la tierra. Eso {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dolió profundamente en el corazón.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regretta d’avoir fait {{gender:l’humanité|l’homme}} sur la terre, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fut peiné jusqu’au fond de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} cœur.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} eut du regret d’avoir fait {{gender:les êtres humains|l’homme}} sur la terre, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} cœur fut profondément troublé.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a été triste d’avoir fait les humains sur la terre. Cela {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a fait très mal au cœur.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akajuta kwa kuwa aliwafanya wanadamu duniani, akahuzunika moyoni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.
sw.B: Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akajuta kwa kuwa aliwafanya wanadamu duniani, na moyo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ukafadhaika sana.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisikitika kwa kuwa aliwafanya watu duniani. Jambo hilo liliumiza sana moyo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hối tiếc rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nên loài người trên đất, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} buồn rầu trong lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hối tiếc vì đã làm nên loài người trên đất, và lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vô cùng đau buồn.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} buồn vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nên loài người trên đất. Lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đau đớn vô cùng.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 땅 위에 사람을 만드신 것을 후회하시고, 마음에 근심하셨다.
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 땅 위에 사람을 만드신 것을 후회하시고, 마음 깊이 괴로워하셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 땅 위에 사람을 만드신 것을 슬퍼하셨다. 마음이 몹시 아프셨다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lamentou ter feito {{gender:a humanidade|o homem}} na terra, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} sentiu dor no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} coração.
pt.B: Assim {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lamentou ter feito {{gender:os seres humanos|o homem}} na terra, e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} coração ficou profundamente aflito.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ficou triste por ter feito as pessoas na terra. Isso doeu muito no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} coração.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሰውን በምድር ላይ ስለ ሠራ ተጸጸተ፤ እስከ ልቡም ድረስ ተከዘ።
am.B: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሰውን በምድር ላይ በመሥራቱ ተጸጸተ፤ ልቡም እጅግ ታወከ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሰዎችን በምድር ላይ በመሥራቱ አዘነ። ልቡ እጅግ ተጎዳ።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पछताए कि उन्होंने पृथ्वी पर मनुष्य को बनाया, और वे अपने मन में दुखी हुए।
hi.B: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पछताए कि उन्होंने पृथ्वी पर मनुष्य को बनाया था, और उनका मन बहुत दुखी हुआ।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को दुख हुआ कि उन्होंने धरती पर लोगों को बनाया था। इससे उनके मन को गहरी चोट पहुँची।

ru.L: И {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} пожалел, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} создал человека на земле, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} скорбел в своём сердце.
ru.B: И {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} пожалел, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} создал людей на земле, и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} сердце было глубоко опечалено.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сожалел, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сделал людей на земле. Ему было очень больно на сердце.

uk.L: І пожалкував {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зробив людину на землі, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} засмутився до глибини свого серця.
uk.B: Тож {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} пожалкував, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} створив людей на землі, і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} серце глибоко засмутилося.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} жалкував, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зробив людей на землі. Це глибоко ранило {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} серце.

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、地上に人を造ったことを悔やみ、その心に痛みを覚えられた。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、地上に人を造ったことを悔やまれ、心を深く痛められた。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、地上に人を造ったことを悔やまれました。そして、心をひどく痛められました。

id.L: Dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} menyesal bahwa {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} telah menjadikan manusia di bumi, dan hati-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} sangat berduka.
id.B: Jadi {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} menyesal bahwa {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} telah menjadikan manusia di bumi, dan hati-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} sangat pedih.
id.R: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} menyesal bahwa {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} telah menjadikan manusia di bumi. Hati-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} sangat sedih.

zh.L: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}因{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}在地上造了人而后悔，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的心深感痛苦。
zh.B: 于是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}为{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}在地上造了人感到懊悔，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的心非常难过。
zh.R: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}很难过，因为{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}在地上造了人。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的心深深地受了伤。

tl.L: At nagsisi {{divine_name:ang PANGINOON|si Yahweh}} na ginawa {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} ang tao sa lupa, at nagdalamhati {{deity_pronoun:siya|Siya}} sa {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} puso.
tl.B: Kaya nagsisi {{divine_name:ang PANGINOON|si Yahweh}} na ginawa {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} ang tao sa lupa, at labis na nabagabag ang {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} puso.
tl.R: Nalungkot {{divine_name:ang PANGINOON|si Yahweh}} na ginawa {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} ang mga tao sa lupa. Labis na nasaktan ang {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} puso.

decisions.choice: regretted: God's sorrow, said in human terms
decisions.reason: The verb, the one Lamech used in naming Noah (5:29), means to be sorry, to grieve or to change one's course. The Bible says God does not change his mind as a human does (Numbers 23:19; 1 Samuel 15:29), yet it often speaks of him relenting or regretting (Exodus 32:14; Jonah 3:10). Here it shows that human evil truly grieves God; it does not mean he made a mistake or did not foresee it.

decisions.choice: grieved to his heart: deeply pained
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the "pain" of 3:16-17: the pain of the woman and the toil of the man. Now God himself feels pain at what humankind has done.

decisions.choice: lamentó (L); le pesó (B); le dio mucha tristeza (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is God's sorrow and grief, said in human terms (m1). In current Spanish "arrepentirse" mostly means repenting of a wrong one has done, which is not the point here, so the levels use words of regret and sorrow. The same choice is made for "I regret" in verse 7.

decisions.choice: regretta (L); eut du regret (B); a été triste (R)
decisions.reason: The verb (niham) means to be sorry or grieved (m1). "Se repentir" now says in French that one turns from a wrong one has done, which the text does not say of God; "regretter" says the sorrow.

decisions.choice: akajuta (L, B); alisikitika (R)
decisions.reason: The verb (niham) means to be sorry or grieved (m1). "Kujuta" says that sorrow; "kutubu" is to repent of a wrong, and "kughairi" mainly to call off a plan, neither of which the text says here.

decisions.choice: "hối tiếc"
decisions.reason: God's sorrow is said in human terms (m1). "ăn năn" would suggest repenting of a wrong; "hối tiếc" (regret) does not.

decisions.choice: lamentou (L, B); ficou triste (R)
decisions.reason: "Arrepender-se" suggests turning from a wrong one has done, which is not what the verb says of God (m1); "lamentar" is to be sorry about something. Literal says "sentiu dor" for the second verb, which keeps the link with the "dor" of 3:16 (m2).

decisions.choice: "пожалел" (L, B); "сожалел" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of God's sorrow in human terms (m1). "Раскаяться" now means to repent of a wrong one has done, which the verse does not say.

decisions.choice: "пожалкував"
decisions.reason: God's sorrow said in human terms (meaning decision m1); "розкаявся" would suggest repentance for a wrong.

decisions.choice: "悔やまれ" for regretted; "心を痛められた" for grieved to his heart
decisions.reason: The text speaks of God's sorrow in human terms (m1, m2); 悔やむ carries sorrow over what was done without suggesting a mistake corrected, as 後悔 can.

decisions.choice: "menyesal" at every level
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew verb is God's sorrow over what he made (m1), not a change of course announced, so every level says "menyesal", as the English says regretted; compare Jonah 3:9.

decisions.choice: "nagsisi" (regretted) at Literal and Balanced; "nalungkot" (was sorry) at Readable
decisions.reason: "magsisi" is the ordinary Tagalog word for regretting what one has done, said of God in human terms (m1), as the Hebrew does. Readable says "nalungkot", which does not suggest God did wrong, as the English Readable says "was sorry".

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה אֶמְחֶ֨ה אֶת־הָאָדָ֤ם אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָ֨אתִי֙ מֵעַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה מֵֽאָדָם֙ עַד־בְּהֵמָ֔ה עַד־רֶ֖מֶשׂ וְעַד־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י נִחַ֖מְתִּי כִּ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said YHWH, I will wipe out humankind whom I created from on [the] face of the ground, from humankind to animal[s], to creeping thing[s], and to [the] bird[s] of the heavens, for I regret that I made them.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "I will wipe out {{gender:humankind|man}} whom I created from the face of the ground, from {{gender:humankind|man}} to animals, to creeping things, and to the birds of the heavens, for I regret that I made them."
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "I will wipe from the face of the earth the human beings I have created, and with them the animals, the creatures that move along the ground and the birds of the sky, for I regret that I made them."
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "I will wipe out the people I created. I will remove them from the earth, along with the animals, the creatures that crawl and the birds of the sky. I am sorry I made them."

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: «Borraré {{gender:a la humanidad|al hombre}} que creé de la superficie del suelo, desde {{gender:la humanidad|el hombre}} hasta los animales, hasta los seres que se arrastran y hasta las aves de los cielos, porque lamento haberlos hecho».
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «Borraré de la faz de la tierra a los seres humanos que he creado, y con ellos a los animales, a los seres que se arrastran por el suelo y a las aves del cielo, porque me pesa haberlos hecho».
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «Voy a borrar a la gente que creé. La quitaré de la tierra, junto con los animales, las criaturas que se arrastran y las aves del cielo. Siento mucho haberlos hecho».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « J’effacerai {{gender:l’humanité que j’ai créée|l’homme que j’ai créé}} de la face du sol, depuis {{gender:l’humanité|l’homme}} jusqu’au bétail, jusqu’aux bêtes qui rampent et jusqu’aux oiseaux du ciel, car je regrette de les avoir faits. »
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « J’effacerai de la surface de la terre les êtres humains que j’ai créés, et avec eux le bétail, les bêtes qui se déplacent sur le sol et les oiseaux du ciel, car je regrette de les avoir faits. »
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : « Je vais faire disparaître les gens que j’ai créés. Je vais les enlever de la terre, avec les animaux, les bêtes qui rampent et les oiseaux du ciel. Je regrette de les avoir faits. »

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Nitawafutilia mbali wanadamu niliowaumba kutoka katika uso wa ardhi, tangu wanadamu hadi wanyama, hadi viumbe vitambaavyo, na hadi ndege wa angani, kwa maana ninajuta kwamba niliwafanya."
sw.B: Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Nitawafuta kutoka katika uso wa dunia wanadamu niliowaumba, na pamoja nao wanyama, viumbe vinavyotambaa ardhini na ndege wa angani, kwa maana ninajuta kwamba niliwafanya."
sw.R: Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Nitawafutilia mbali watu niliowaumba. Nitawaondoa duniani, pamoja na wanyama, viumbe vinavyotambaa na ndege wa angani. Ninasikitika kwamba niliwafanya."

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Ta sẽ xóa bỏ loài người mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sáng tạo khỏi mặt đất, từ loài người cho đến thú vật, đến loài bò sát, và đến chim trên trời, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hối tiếc đã làm nên chúng."
vi.B: Vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Ta sẽ xóa bỏ khỏi mặt đất loài người mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sáng tạo, cùng với thú vật, loài bò sát và chim trời, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hối tiếc đã làm nên chúng."
vi.R: Vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Ta sẽ xóa bỏ loài người mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sáng tạo. Ta sẽ cất họ khỏi mặt đất, cùng với thú vật, những loài bò sát và chim trời. Ta buồn vì đã làm nên chúng."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "내가 창조한 사람을 땅의 표면에서 쓸어버리겠다. 사람에서부터 짐승과 기어 다니는 것과 하늘의 새까지 [쓸어버리겠다]. 내가 그것들을 만든 것을 후회하기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "내가 창조한 사람을 땅 위에서 쓸어버리겠다. 그들과 함께 짐승과 땅 위를 기어 다니는 것과 하늘의 새까지 쓸어버리겠다. 내가 그것들을 만든 것을 후회한다."
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "내가 창조한 사람들을 쓸어버리겠다. 그들을 땅 위에서 없애 버리고, 짐승과 기어 다니는 것과 하늘의 새도 함께 없애 버리겠다. 내가 그것들을 만든 것이 슬프다."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Apagarei {{gender:a humanidade|o homem}} que criei da face do solo, desde {{gender:a humanidade|o homem}} até os animais, até as criaturas rastejantes e até as aves dos céus, porque lamento tê-los feito."
pt.B: Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Apagarei da face da terra os seres humanos que criei, e com eles os animais, as criaturas que se movem rente ao chão e as aves do céu, porque lamento tê-los feito."
pt.R: Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Vou destruir as pessoas que criei. Vou tirá-las da terra, junto com os animais, os pequenos animais que rastejam e as aves do céu. Estou triste por tê-los feito."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም አለ፦ «የፈጠርኩትን ሰው ከመሬት ፊት ላይ እደመስሳለሁ፤ ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ፣ እስከ ሚሳቡት፣ እስከ ሰማያት ወፎችም ድረስ፤ ስለ ሠራኋቸው ተጸጽቻለሁና።»
am.B: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለ፦ «የፈጠርኳቸውን ሰዎች፣ ከእነርሱም ጋር እንስሳትን፣ በምድር ላይ የሚሳቡትን ፍጥረታትና የሰማይ ወፎችን ከምድር ገጽ ላይ እደመስሳለሁ፤ ስለ ሠራኋቸው ተጸጽቻለሁና።»
am.R: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለ፦ «የፈጠርኳቸውን ሰዎች አጠፋለሁ። ከእንስሳት፣ ከሚሳቡ ትናንሽ ፍጥረታትና ከሰማይ ወፎች ጋር ከምድር ላይ አስወግዳቸዋለሁ። ስለ ሠራኋቸው አዝናለሁ።»

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा, "मैं मनुष्य को, जिसे मैंने रचा, भूमि के मुख पर से मिटा दूँगा, मनुष्य से लेकर पशु तक, रेंगनेवाले जंतुओं तक, और आकाश के पक्षियों तक, क्योंकि मैं पछताता हूँ कि मैंने उन्हें बनाया।"
hi.B: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा, "मैंने जिन मनुष्यों को रचा है, उन्हें मैं पृथ्वी के मुख पर से मिटा दूँगा, और उनके साथ पशुओं को, ज़मीन पर रेंगनेवाले जंतुओं को और आकाश के पक्षियों को भी, क्योंकि मैं पछताता हूँ कि मैंने उन्हें बनाया।"
hi.R: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा, "मैंने जिन लोगों को रचा, उन्हें मैं मिटा दूँगा। मैं उन्हें धरती पर से हटा दूँगा, और उनके साथ जानवरों, रेंगनेवाले जीवों और आकाश के पक्षियों को भी। मुझे दुख है कि मैंने उन्हें बनाया।"

ru.L: И {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал: «Я сотру человека, которого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сотворил, с лица земли, от человека до скота, до ползающих и до птиц небес, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} жалею, что создал их.»
ru.B: И {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал: «Я сотру с лица земли людей, которых {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сотворил, а с ними и скот, существ, которые ползают по земле, и птиц неба, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} жалею, что создал их.»
ru.R: И {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал: «Я уничтожу людей, которых {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сотворил. Я уберу их с земли вместе с животными, ползающими существами и птицами неба. Мне жаль, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделал их.»

uk.L: І сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: «Я зітру людину, яку {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} створив, з поверхні землі, від людини до тварин, до плазунів і до птахів небес, бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} жалкую, що зробив їх.»
uk.B: Тож {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав: «Я зітру з поверхні землі людей, яких {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} створив, а разом із ними тварин, плазунів і птахів неба, бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} жалкую, що зробив їх.»
uk.R: Тож {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав: «Я знищу людей, яких {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} створив. Я заберу їх із землі разом із тваринами, плазунами й птахами неба. Мені шкода, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} їх зробив.»

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言われた。「わたしが創造した人を、地の面から消し去る。人から家畜、這うもの、天の鳥に至るまで。わたしはそれらを造ったことを悔やむからである。」
ja.B: そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言われた。「わたしが創造した人を、地の面から消し去ろう。人とともに、家畜も、地を這うものも、空の鳥も。わたしはそれらを造ったことを悔やむからだ。」
ja.R: そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言われました。「わたしが造った人を消し去ろう。地上から取り除こう。動物も、地をはう小さな生き物も、空の鳥も一緒に。わたしはそれらを造ったことを悔やんでいる。」

id.L: Dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman, "Aku akan menghapus manusia yang telah {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} ciptakan dari atas permukaan tanah, dari manusia sampai binatang, sampai binatang melata, dan sampai burung-burung di langit, sebab {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} menyesal bahwa {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} telah menjadikan mereka."
id.B: Jadi {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman, "Aku akan menghapus dari muka bumi manusia yang telah {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} ciptakan, dan bersama mereka binatang-binatang, binatang yang merayap di tanah, dan burung-burung di langit, sebab {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} menyesal telah menjadikan mereka."
id.R: Jadi {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman, "Aku akan memusnahkan manusia yang telah {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} ciptakan. Aku akan melenyapkan mereka dari bumi, bersama binatang-binatang, binatang yang merayap, dan burung-burung di langit. Aku menyesal telah menjadikan mereka."

zh.L: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}说：“我要把我所创造的人从地面上抹去，从人到牲畜、到爬物、到天上的飞鸟，因为我后悔造了他们。”
zh.B: 于是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}说：“我要把我所造的人从地面上抹去，连同牲畜、在地上爬行的动物和天空的飞鸟，因为我后悔造了他们。”
zh.R: 于是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}说：“我要除掉我所造的人。我要把他们从地上除去，还有动物、爬行的动物和天空的鸟。我很后悔造了他们。”

tl.L: At sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, "Papawiin ko ang tao na aking nilikha mula sa ibabaw ng lupa, mula sa tao hanggang sa mga hayop, hanggang sa mga gumagapang, at hanggang sa mga ibon sa langit, sapagkat nagsisisi ako na ginawa ko sila."
tl.B: Kaya sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, "Papawiin ko sa ibabaw ng lupa ang mga taong aking nilikha, at kasama nila ang mga hayop, ang mga nilalang na gumagapang sa lupa at ang mga ibon sa langit, sapagkat nagsisisi ako na ginawa ko sila."
tl.R: Kaya sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, "Lilipulin ko ang mga taong nilikha ko. Aalisin ko sila sa lupa, kasama ang mga hayop, ang mga nilalang na gumagapang at ang mga ibon sa langit. Nalulungkot ako na ginawa ko sila."

alignments.target_span: the creatures that move along the ground

decisions.choice: wipe out: wipe away, blot out
decisions.reason: The verb means to wipe clean, as a dish is wiped (2 Kings 21:13), or to blot out a name from a record (Exodus 32:32). The flood will wash the earth clean.

decisions.choice: from humankind to animals: the animals share the judgment
decisions.reason: The animals were given to humankind's rule (1:26-28), so they share its fate. The list runs through the creatures of the sixth and fifth days in reverse, as if creation were being undone.

decisions.choice: "papawiin" (wipe away) at Literal and Balanced; "lilipulin" (destroy) at Readable
decisions.reason: "pawiin" is to wipe away or blot out (m1), the verb of 7:4 and 7:23 too; Readable says "lipulin", to destroy completely.

pt.R: Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se agradou de Noé.

ru.B: Но Ной нашёл благоволение у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

decisions.choice: found favor: received grace and kindness
decisions.reason: The word means favor or grace, kindness that is given, not earned. In Hebrew its two consonants are those of Noah's name reversed, a small play on words.

decisions.choice: favor
decisions.reason: "Favor" is the usual English for this phrase ("find favor in the eyes of"). The word is the Old Testament's word for grace; "grace" as a key term belongs to the Greek word.

decisions.choice: trouva grâce aux yeux (L); obtint la faveur (B)
decisions.reason: "Trouver grâce aux yeux de" is the ordinary French idiom for this Hebrew phrase, and "grâce" there means favor (m1), not the New Testament key term; Balanced says "la faveur", as the English says "favor".

decisions.choice: kibali
decisions.reason: The word (chen) is favor received from someone (m1). Swahili "kibali" says that; "neema" is kept for the New Testament key term grace, as the English keeps "grace" for the Greek word.

decisions.choice: "được ơn"
decisions.reason: "được ơn" is the everyday Vietnamese for finding favor; "ân điển" is kept for the key term grace in the New Testament.

decisions.choice: favor
decisions.reason: "Achar graça" is the older Bible wording, but in Brazilian Portuguese it now means to find something funny; "achar favor" says what the phrase means (m1), as the English says "favor".

decisions.choice: "अनुग्रह" (favor)
decisions.reason: The word means grace and kindness received (m1). "अनुग्रह" is the translation's word for grace.

decisions.choice: "благоволение"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is favour and kindness shown to someone (m1). "Благодать" is kept in the New Testament for the Greek charis; "благоволение" is the favour one finds with someone.

decisions.choice: "знайшов ласку"
decisions.reason: Book-wide for "find favor in the eyes of" (18:3; 19:19; 30:27; 32:5; 33:8-15; 39:4; 47:29; 50:4): "ласка" is the favour of one who is greater, said the same way of God and of people.

decisions.choice: "恵み" for favor
decisions.reason: Favor here is grace and kindness received from God (m1); 恵み is the key term for grace in the Japanese New Testament, and the link is wanted.

decisions.choice: "mendapat kasih karunia" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is grace and kindness received (m1); "kasih karunia" is the glossary's key term for grace. Readable says it with God as subject, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "恩惠" (L); "恩待" (B)
decisions.reason: To find favor is to receive grace and kindness (meaning decision m1). As the English keeps "grace" as a key term for the New Testament, Chinese keeps "恩典" for it and says "恩惠" / "恩待" in this phrase.

decisions.choice: "nakasumpong ng biyaya" (found grace) at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is grace and kindness shown (m1), and "biyaya" is the glossary word for grace; Literal keeps the Hebrew "found grace in the eyes of". Balanced and Readable say that the LORD was pleased with him, as in Ruth 2:2, 10.

records.literal_gloss: These [are the] generations of Noah. Noah [was] a man righteous, blameless he was among his generations; with God walked Noah.

en.L: These [are] the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generations; Noah walked with God.
en.B: This is the story of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time, and he walked with God.
en.R: This is the story of Noah. Noah did what was right and lived a good life, unlike the other people of his time. He was close to God.

es.L: Estas [son] las generaciones de Noé. Noé era un hombre justo, intachable entre sus generaciones; Noé caminaba con Dios.
es.B: Esta es la historia de Noé. Noé era un hombre justo, intachable entre la gente de su tiempo, y caminaba con Dios.
es.R: Esta es la historia de Noé. Noé hacía lo correcto y vivía una vida buena, a diferencia de las demás personas de su tiempo. Vivía muy unido a Dios.

fr.L: Voici les générations de Noé. Noé était un homme juste, intègre parmi ses générations ; Noé marchait avec Dieu.
fr.B: Voici l’histoire de Noé. Noé était un homme juste, irréprochable parmi les gens de son temps, et il marchait avec Dieu.
fr.R: Voici l’histoire de Noé. Noé faisait ce qui est juste et menait une vie droite, contrairement aux autres gens de son époque. Il était proche de Dieu.

sw.L: Hivi [ni] vizazi vya Nuhu. Nuhu alikuwa mtu mwenye haki, mkamilifu katika vizazi vyake; Nuhu alitembea pamoja na Mungu.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo habari ya Nuhu. Nuhu alikuwa mtu mwenye haki, asiye na lawama kati ya watu wa wakati wake, naye alitembea pamoja na Mungu.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo habari ya Nuhu. Nuhu alitenda yaliyo sawa na kuishi maisha mema, tofauti na watu wengine wa wakati wake. Alikuwa karibu na Mungu.

vi.L: Đây [là] dòng dõi của Nô-ê. Nô-ê là một người công chính, trọn vẹn giữa những người đồng thời với ông; Nô-ê đồng đi với Đức Chúa Trời.

vi.R: Đây là câu chuyện về dòng họ của Nô-ê. Nô-ê làm điều đúng và sống một đời tốt lành, không giống như những người khác cùng thời với ông. Ông sống gần gũi với Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 노아의 계보는 이러하다. 노아는 의로운 사람이었고, 자기 세대 가운데서 흠이 없었다. 노아는 하나님과 함께 걸었다.

ko.R: 노아의 집안 이야기는 이러하다. 노아는 바르게 살았고, 그 시대의 다른 사람들과 달리 착하게 살았다. 그는 하나님과 가까이 지냈다.

pt.B: Esta é a história de Noé. Noé era um homem justo, irrepreensível entre as pessoas do seu tempo, e andava com Deus.

ru.R: Вот история Ноя. Ной поступал правильно и жил хорошей жизнью, не так, как другие люди его времени. Он был близок к Богу.
